name: catalog
title: Reference catalog
summary: A large reference catalog of items imported nightly from an outside source, searched and resolved by name in memory (exact, alias, close spellings); staff watch the sync log, sync now, and retire or restore items.

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE
env.doc: Registered source to sync from (http, file, or one the app registers). Unset: http when CATALOG_SOURCE_URL is set, else file when CATALOG_SOURCE_FILE is set, else no syncs.

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE_URL
env.doc: The http source: an https URL serving every item as a JSON array or NDJSON (gzip allowed), fetched through safehttp.

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE_TOKEN
env.doc: Bearer token sent to CATALOG_SOURCE_URL, if the feed needs one.
env.source: The catalog provider's API or feed settings.

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE_FILE
env.doc: The file source: a JSON array or NDJSON file on the server (development and offline machines; internal/catalog/devdata/elements.ndjson to try it).

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest response the http source accepts, in MB after decompression (1 to 4096).

env.name: CATALOG_SOURCE_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Time a source gets to send the whole catalog (10s to 50m).

env.name: CATALOG_SYNC_HOUR
env.doc: UTC hour of the nightly sync (0 to 23); -1 turns it off (staff and app code can still sync).

env.name: CATALOG_MAX_RETIRE_PERCENT
env.doc: Safety valve: a sync that would retire more than this share of the active items (catalogs of 100 or more) is refused and changes nothing; an empty pull is always refused. Staff can force one.

env.name: CATALOG_MAX_ITEMS
env.doc: Most items a source may send; a sync over it fails (the catalog is held in memory on every instance).

env.name: CATALOG_PUBLIC_READS
env.doc: Serve the catalog, search, items, resolve and the client index without sign-in. false puts them behind sign-in.

env.name: CATALOG_RELOAD_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often each instance checks the catalog version and reloads after a change elsewhere (1s to 10m).

env.name: CATALOG_RESOLVE_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: Resolve requests (up to 500 names each) per person, or per IP when signed out, per minute.

env.name: CATALOG_CLIENT_INDEX_MAX
env.doc: Largest catalog served as a compact index for search on the device (GET /v1/catalog/index); larger ones are searched on the server only. 0 turns it off.

stitch: Decide who reads the catalog: anyone (default) or signed-in people (CATALOG_PUBLIC_READS=false). Rename "Catalog" in web/src/features/catalog/nav.ts and mobile/src/features/catalog/registry.tsx to what the product calls it.

Choose the source: CATALOG_SOURCE_URL for a JSON array or NDJSON feed (CATALOG_SOURCE_TOKEN if it needs one), or catalog.RegisterSource("name", factory) from an init() in backend/internal/api/stitch_catalog.go for any other API, then CATALOG_SOURCE=name. Map the outside fields to Item: key (stable), name, aliases, category, subtitle, image_url, attrs, ref_price and currency.
Set CATALOG_SYNC_HOUR after the source's own daily refresh, and CATALOG_MAX_RETIRE_PERCENT to the largest drop that can be real; run Admin → Catalog → Sync now once and read the log.

Consumers call Service.Lookup, Service.Search and Service.Item (find the Service among d.Modules with a type assertion, or import the package when your feature requires catalog); treat Match "fuzzy" as a guess to confirm, and Item.Retired as "no longer listed".
Image hosts: item images render unoptimised on web unless their host is in next.config.ts images.remotePatterns and web/src/lib/images.ts.
Replace the development elements (backend/internal/catalog/devdata/elements.ndjson, seeded by cmd/seed into an empty catalog) with a sample of your own source.
